head.h1: Reunion Catering in Dubai — What It Costs and How to Book

opening_paragraph: Reunion catering in Dubai from myCHEF runs from AED 120 a head for a family-style buffet to AED 700 and up with a chef cooking on site . Either way the menu is designed for you, the food is cooked fresh and the clearing up is ours, so you reconnect while we run it. Whether it is a family reunion in a villa, a school-friends get-together or a corporate reunion, the food should feel generous and familiar, not formal. Tell us your date, guest count and venue, we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours, with an itemised proposal to follow you can plan around.

new_paragraphs: How much does reunion catering cost in Dubai?

A family-style buffet or drop-off starts at AED 120 per person, BBQ and live stations at AED 150, and a chef cooking and plating at your venue is AED 700 to AED 950 a head. Fixed packages run from AED 1,200. Minimums are 10 guests on volume formats, 20 on a buffet and a minimum order value of AED 900. Send your numbers for an itemised quote.
What is included in reunion catering?
Included is menu design, a vetted chef cooking on site, service staff where needed, plating, setup and full cleanup — one team from first enquiry to the last plate carried out.
Can you cater a reunion at home?
Yes. A private reunion chef works within your kitchen and dining space, bringing the right equipment scaled to your home, so you host in your own space without the work.
Do you offer halal and dietary options?

Yes. Menus are halal by default, with vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free and nut-conscious options planned in and labelled, not added as an afterthought. They are available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless controls have been confirmed for your booking.
How far ahead should I book?

Allow 72 hours for a standard catering package, three to five days where live stations or extra staff are involved, and five to seven days for a bespoke menu or a larger gathering. We recommend booking as early as possible. Lead times depend on guest numbers, menu complexity, staffing, equipment, location and partner availability. Short lead time on a reunion is worth a message: some partners keep capacity for late requests.
Where are you based — is there an address I can visit?

There is no walk-in address, because myCHEF is a mobile service: the chef and the equipment travel to your villa, apartment or venue anywhere in Dubai. The company is registered as Numini (myCHEF) FZC at Business Centre, Sharjah Publishing City Free Zone. Menus, quotes and bookings are handled by message and email, and on the day the team arrives at your address instead of you coming to ours.
How many guests can you cater for?
Any size — from an intimate dozen at home to a hundred-plus at a villa or venue. We scale the menu, stations and staff to your headcount.
Can you handle a corporate reunion?
Yes. Corporate reunion catering is tuned to a professional but warm register, from canapés and a seated course to a considered buffet for alumni and company milestone events.
For reunion catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

add_block.new_heading: What is the leading catering company in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: There is no single leading catering company in Dubai, and any caterer who claims the title is quoting their own marketing back at you. The market splits three ways. Hotel banqueting teams take the large formal events, a handful of volume caterers take corporate and buffet work at scale, and a smaller group of chef-led operators handle private homes and villas — which is where a reunion almost always sits. The useful question is not who leads, but which of those three fits the group you are feeding.

Four things separate a caterer worth booking from one worth skipping, and you can check all four before you pay anything. Is the price published, or drawn out of you in stages? Is the quote itemised line by line, or a single per-head number with the extras waiting? Is one named person accountable on the day? And can the kitchen's food licence be produced if you ask? MyCHEF publishes per-head figures on this page, itemises every quote, gives you one point of contact from the first message to the last plate carried out, and works only with licensed culinary partners whose documentation is verified before a booking is confirmed. Put whoever else you are shortlisting through the same four questions — the answers will rank them for you.
